categories.name: Chairs & benches
categories.sample: A rustic oak dining chair for adults. The seat is 18 inches above the floor. Overall dimensions are 34 by 18 by 20 inches. Supports 250 pounds. A reinforced backrest provides support. All assembly hardware is included. Wipe clean with a damp cloth.

categories.name: Mugs & cups
categories.sample: A handmade ceramic mug with a glossy blue glaze. Holds 350 ml. Hand wash only. Decorated with stars and moons. Your initials can be added. One mug is included.

categories.name: Candles
categories.sample: A soy wax candle scented with lavender and cedar. It burns for approximately 40 hours and uses a braided cotton wick. Trim the wick before each use. The jar is amber brown.

categories.name: Necklaces
categories.sample: A sterling silver pendant necklace set with moonstone. The chain is 45 centimeters long and fastens with a lobster clasp. Wipe gently with a polishing cloth. Add an engraved initial.

categories.name: Shirts & tops
categories.sample: A cotton T-shirt in navy blue, offered in sizes small through extra large. A relaxed fit with short sleeves. Machine wash cold. Printed with woodland animals.

categories.name: Art prints
categories.sample: A botanical art print made using archival giclee printing. Printed on cotton paper, measuring 8 by 10 inches. Delivered unframed. The illustration features ferns and wildflowers.

categories.name: Bags & totes
categories.sample: A canvas tote bag with a zip closure and an adjustable shoulder strap from 80 to 120 cm. Measures 35 by 30 by 12 cm. A hidden interior pocket holds small items. Spot clean only.

categories.name: Blankets & throws
categories.sample: A wool throw blanket measuring 130 by 170 cm. Dry clean only. The color is forest green. One blanket is included, with an optional embroidered monogram.
